definitions.explanation: The deepest, most hidden aspects of a subject or discipline. Often refers to knowledge or truths that are not easily accessible and require deep study to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深奥|しんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧。
examples.english: To master the profound depths of a discipline.
There are still many mysteries in the profound depths of nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、ようやく⟦{哲学|てつがく}→哲学：03548_tetsugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深奥|しんおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After years of research, I was finally able to touch upon the deeper mysteries of philosophy.

notes:
{深奥|しんおう} refers to the deepest, most hidden aspects of a subject — the profound mysteries that require deep study to reach.

COMPOUNDS:
{深|しん} (deep) + {奥|おう} (inner depths, recesses).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深奥|しんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧: to plumb the depths of
- {深奥|しんおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: to touch upon the mysteries of
- ⟦{学問|がくもん}→学問：02604_gakumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深奥|しんおう}: the profound depths of a discipline
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深奥|しんおう}: the mysteries of nature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {深遠|しんえん}: profound, far-reaching (emphasizes depth of thought; used for ideas or philosophy)
- ⟦{奥義|おうぎ}→奥義：14935_ougi⟧: secret teaching, esoteric principle (used in martial arts or traditional arts)

REGISTER:
A literary and formal word. Rarely used in casual conversation. Common in academic writing, philosophy, and essays about the arts.
